purpose: Editorial readiness classification for Metkagram study sets. Tiers describe corpus quality and review state, not learning efficacy.
principles: Stable public Pattern and study-set IDs are preserved; a lower tier is a remediation signal, not a deletion instruction.
A reviewed core requires human-curated examples plus a clean deterministic quality baseline.
Automated duplicate and linguistic signals prioritise review but do not replace human linguistic judgement.
A set can contain reviewed Pattern overlays even while the broader legacy set remains in remediation.

tiers.label: reviewed-core
tiers.meaning: Reviewed thinking-in-language sets with curated EN/DE Frames, complete Russian learner support and zero duplicate-affected rate in the current frozen quality baseline.

tiers.label: quality-gated-practice
tiers.meaning: Practice sets protected by build-time gates for example uniqueness and translation completeness; current frozen duplicate-affected rate is zero.

tiers.label: remediation-priority
tiers.meaning: Legacy sets with the highest editorial review priority according to duplicate density, audit severity and product relevance. The set remains usable as a compatibility/reference layer while reviewed Frames are added.

fallback.label: legacy-reference
fallback.rule: Every established study set not explicitly assigned to A, B or D.
fallback.meaning: Stable corpus material retained for coverage and public-ID compatibility. Use selectively until a reviewed core is established.
